### 4.3 Intestinal Secretions (Succus Entericus)
- **Crypts of Lieberkühn**: Simple tubular glands situated between intestinal villi bases containing:
  - **Stem Cells**: Replenish the intestinal epithelial lining every $3\text{--}5\text{ days}$.
  - **Paneth Cells**: Located at crypt bases; secrete antimicrobial **lysozyme** and zinc.
- **Succus Entericus ($\text{pH } 7.8$)**: Alkaline intestinal juice secreted by crypts and Brunner's glands ($1\text{--}2\text{ L/day}$). Contains Disaccharidases (**Maltase, Lactase, Sucrase**), Dipeptidases, Intestinal Lipases, and Nucleosidases / Nucleotidases.
